text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I go through
this, this
energy and atmosphere always
gets my heart
racing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. When I think about how all I
must do is
to run as myself, it sets me
right at ease, strangely
enough.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho—the final race of the
Classic
Triple Crown. I'll be able to hit
one of my
milestones today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to sprint my way through this
race with
all my strength!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hi there! So how's Dia doing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything has been smooth sailing so
far.
Moreover, Satono Diamond hasn't
mentioned her
jinx even once today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Satono Diamond takes that as a
good
omen.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Satono Diamond! She looks
ready to take
on the world!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She said in interviews that said she
wasn't able to
run her best in the Satsuki
Sho or the Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: If that's true, then I can't wait to see what she looks like when she does do her best!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure we'll be able to see Dia
at the top
of her game today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I mean, just look at her! This is the first
time I've
ever seen her this focused!
